scientific_integrity: An exact algebraic theorem for an explicit idealized weighted-work functional; exhaustive finite examples do not prove the theorem and are only verification aids.
scientific_limitations: Exact geometric positive level weights and binary adjacent step ratios only.
Overhead is an assumed additive per-fine-update charge, not a measured overhead for a particular code.
No physical-time accuracy, stability, wall-clock, irregular geometry, or general-cost optimality claim.
A different equivalent result may exist in implementation literature.
title: Optimal one-switch partial subcycling with geometric AMR level costs
